audience: support and sales teams who chat with website visitors in Chatra

useCases.title: Look up a chat visitor
useCases.text: The AI reads a visitor's name and contact details, form answers, location, browser, dashboard link and the pages viewed in the latest visit.

useCases.title: Update a visitor's name, email, phone or notes
useCases.text: The AI changes the basic info of a visitor, as an agent would in the dashboard. Only the fields you give change.

useCases.title: Send a chat message to a visitor
useCases.text: The AI sends a message to a visitor as an agent. The visitor sees it at once in the chat window.

useCases.title: Push an automated message to a visitor
useCases.text: The AI sends an automated message such as an order status or product update to a visitor who is linked to Chatra by a clientId.

useCases.title: Edit or delete a message you sent
useCases.text: The AI replaces the text of a sent agent message or pushed message, or deletes one. Deleting cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Read a message by its id
useCases.text: The AI reads one chat message or pushed message: its text, sender type, visitor, agent and time. The id comes from a send call or a webhook.
